description: Index a project into the knowledge graph: parses 20+ languages (TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C/C++, C#, Ruby, PHP, Swift, …) plus Markdown, PDF and email, extracts symbols and call edges, detects communities and traces execution flows. Reuses a fresh index unless force=true. Writes only to the myceliums data directory, never to the project.

force.description: Force full re-analysis even if cache is fresh (default: false)

max_age_minutes.description: Maximum cache age in minutes before re-analysis (default: 60)

path.description: Path to the project directory to analyze

skip_embeddings.description: Skip embedding generation for faster analysis (default: false)

name: analyze

description: Show a function, method or class with everything needed to understand it before changing it: its source, signature, file and line range, and who calls it and what it calls (with how each call edge was resolved).

max_source_lines.description: Most source lines shown; longer bodies are cut with a note (default 120, max 5000)

repo_id.description: Repository ID (default: the indexed repository containing the working directory)

symbol_name.description: Symbol: name, qualified name, or file_path:qualified_name

name: explain_symbol

description: What does this function or method call? Lists the functions a symbol calls with file and line; depth > 1 follows the calls further down. Each callee carries how its CALLS edge was resolved (exact, import, name-match, ambiguous).

depth.description: Hops to follow: 1 = direct only (default 1, max 10)

offset.description: Symbols to skip, for the next page (default 0)

repo_id.description: Repository ID (default: the indexed repository containing the working directory)

symbol_name.description: Symbol: name, qualified name, or file_path:qualified_name

name: find_callees

depth.description: Calls between this symbol and the one asked about (1 = direct).

resolved.description:
How the CALLS edge reaching this symbol was resolved:
exact | import | name-match | ambiguous.

via.description:
For depth > 1: the name of the symbol one step closer to the one
asked about.

index_status.description: Index freshness: analyzed commit vs current HEAD.

notice.description: Set when results were cut: how to fetch the next page.

description: Who calls this function or method? Lists the callers of a symbol with file and line; depth > 1 adds the callers' callers. Each caller carries how its CALLS edge was resolved (exact, import, name-match, ambiguous): verify name-match and ambiguous ones.

depth.description: Hops to follow: 1 = direct only (default 1, max 10)

offset.description: Symbols to skip, for the next page (default 0)

repo_id.description: Repository ID (default: the indexed repository containing the working directory)

symbol_name.description: Symbol: name, qualified name, or file_path:qualified_name

name: find_callers

depth.description: Calls between this symbol and the one asked about (1 = direct).

resolved.description:
How the CALLS edge reaching this symbol was resolved:
exact | import | name-match | ambiguous.

via.description:
For depth > 1: the name of the symbol one step closer to the one
asked about.

index_status.description: Index freshness: analyzed commit vs current HEAD.

notice.description: Set when results were cut: how to fetch the next page.

unlinked_call_sites.description:
Call sites with this symbol's name that got no CALLS edge (more
candidates than the resolver links, or nothing in scope): callers
that may exist but are not counted above.

description: Which functions and methods are never called? Lists those with no incoming CALLS edge, optionally only under a file or directory (path). A candidate list, not proof: entry points, callbacks and calls the resolver missed look unused too; skip known ones with exclude_patterns.

exclude_patterns.description: Comma-separated substrings; symbols whose name contains one are skipped (e.g. known entry points)

offset.description: Symbols to skip, for the next page (default 0)

path.description: Only functions in this file, or under this directory (repository-relative, e.g. src/utils/)

repo_id.description: Repository ID (default: the indexed repository containing the working directory)

name: find_dead_code

index_status.description: Index freshness: analyzed commit vs current HEAD.

notice.description: Set when results were cut: how to fetch the next page.

description: What could break if I change this? For a symbol or a file: every function that calls or imports it, directly and transitively, and the files to check; direct dependents must change too if a signature changes. With neither: the impact of the uncommitted diff (git diff HEAD), or of the diff you pass.

depth.description: Hops to follow from the changed code (default 2, max 10)

diff.description: A unified diff of the change (default when neither symbol_name nor file_path is given: `git diff HEAD` in the repository)

file_path.description: The file you plan to change (repository-relative): all symbols it defines

limit.description: Max report lines per page (default 50, max 500)

offset.description: Report lines to skip, for the next page (default 0)

repo_id.description: Repository ID (default: the indexed repository containing the working directory)

symbol_name.description: The symbol you plan to change (name, qualified name, or file_path:qualified_name). Give at most one of symbol_name, file_path, diff

name: impact_of_change

description: List the analyzed repositories (id, name, path, when and from which commit they were indexed, size). Tools default to the repository of the working directory; pass another one's id as repo_id.

offset.description: Repos to skip, for the next page (default 0)

name: list_repos

analyzed_commit.description: Git commit the index was built from, if the project is a git checkout.

id.description: Pass this as `repo_id` to the other tools.

notice.description: Set when the list was cut (how to fetch the next page) or is empty.

repos.description: One page of repositories, most recently analyzed first.

description: Find where something is implemented: functions, methods, classes and types by name (parseConfig, Item.AsString) or by what the code does ("builds the Set-Cookie header"). Use it instead of grep to locate code; results give kind, file and line range. mode=auto (default) ranks by keyword and meaning when the index has embeddings. Test code ranks below product code unless tests=include or tests=prefer.

explain.description: Show the scoring breakdown of each result (default: false)

mode.description: auto (default): hybrid when the index has embeddings, else keyword. keyword: names and signatures, no model. semantic: meaning only. hybrid: both, fused

offset.description: Results to skip, for the next page (default 0)

query.description: What to find: a name (parseConfig, Item.AsString) or what the code does (builds the Set-Cookie header)

repo_id.description: Repository ID (default: the indexed repository containing the working directory)

rerank.description: Rerank the top 50 hybrid results with a cross-encoder: slower, more precise (default: false)

tests.description: Test code (test files and directories such as *_test.go, *.test.ts, tests/, and #[cfg(test)] modules): demote (default) ranks it below product code, include ranks it like product code, prefer ranks it first. Use include or prefer to find tests

name: search_code

description: How does control get from one function to another? Follows calls from from_symbol down to to_symbol and lists the shortest call chain plus every function on a chain of that length (extra_calls widens it), with file and line.

extra_calls.description: Also list symbols on chains up to this many calls longer than the shortest (default 0, max 5)

from_symbol.description: Where the flow starts: name, qualified name, or file_path:qualified_name

max_depth.description: Longest chain searched, in calls (default 12, max 30)

offset.description: Symbols to skip, for the next page (default 0)

repo_id.description: Repository ID (default: the indexed repository containing the working directory)

to_symbol.description: Where the flow ends: name, qualified name, or file_path:qualified_name

name: trace_flow
